title: Board Play Lod Measures Wiring
description: Wire Rust BoardHost automatic_lod + forced_draw_lod, WASM setAutomaticLod/setForcedDrawLodLabel, BoardRenderer/BoardCanvas props, and board play floating window measures (Automatic LOD toggle + LOD tier select when off) so LOD controls are visible in board play.
summary: Automatic LOD window measure rows now show the live effective tier (e.g. Automatic · Overview) on board play (per pane), scene play, and topology play (board + scene windows). BoardRenderer publishes draw LOD via subscribeDrawLod; BoardCanvas onLodChange and BoardDrawLodReporter wire pane/shell state. Restored selectionChromeIds for WASM descriptor push. E2E updated for new automatic label and exact Overview option match.
